summary: Verified all 3 bug fixes for the Invisacook role on the Service Orders page. Login as Invisacook works, source-filter-chips are correctly hidden, INV-00002 card opens the OrderDetailModal without any 'isInvisacook is not defined' error, and the Invisacook logo (.webp) replaces the orange placeholder + Mastermaq logo. Admin login still shows chips (with new Invisacook chip using .webp) and Invisacook appears in the brand filter popover.
critical_code_review_comments: ServiceOrdersPage.js is >2000 lines — should be split into smaller modules (OrderDetailModal, filters, list card) for maintainability.
Line 992 hardcodes '/assets/invisacook-logo.webp' inline; consider extracting a INVISACOOK_LOGO constant next to MASTERMAQ_LOGO/TELECONTROL_LOGO for consistency.
Two identical inline lists of source chips exist between SOURCE_OPTIONS and the chip rendering array (lines 74-81 vs 753-759). Consider using SOURCE_OPTIONS as single source of truth.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Playwright automation verified: (1) source-filter-chips hidden for Invisacook role (count=0), visible for admin (count=1). (2) INV-00002 order card renders /assets/invisacook-logo.webp in header. (3) Clicking INV-00002 card opens OrderDetailModal — zero console errors, zero page errors, modal contains Status/Prioridade/Nome fields. (4) Admin sees source-chip-invisacook with .webp logo. (5) 'Todas as Marcas' popover lists Invisacook as a selectable brand. All 3 reported bugs are fixed.
rca of the issue: Previous iteration RCA: (1) chip filter didn't respect role — fixed by wrapping in {!isInvisacook && (...)} block at L751. (2) OrderDetailModal used isInvisacook without destructuring from useAuth — fixed by adding isInvisacook to useAuth() destructure at L1701. (3) card header used only MASTERMAQ_LOGO fallback — fixed by adding invisacook branch in the IIFE at L989-1002 that picks '/assets/invisacook-logo.webp' when order.source === 'invisacook'.
